summary: Acrivon Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing that it entered into an asset purchase agreement with Aqilion AB, an unlisted Swedish public limited company, to acquire Aqilion's oral JAK1 inhibitor discovery and development programs, including ACR-525 (formerly AQ280), and a PKC inhibitor preclinical program for inflammatory or autoimmune diseases. Consideration was cash with no milestone or royalty obligations; no price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The transaction appears already consummated at signing, so no financing or regulatory closing condition is described. Watch pipeline integration risk and any associated cash burn or financing needs.
